newsitem.title: POLAND: KRAKCHEMIA TO INVEST PLN 30 MLN IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: KRAKCHEMIA TO INVEST PLN 30 MLN IN 1997.

text.p: The Polish trading company Krakchemia SA wants to invest 30 million zlotys by the end of 1997 in building two supermarkets, firm's deputy president said on Friday.
Henryk Kusnierz told a news conference that the firm planned to build the supermarkets in the southern city of Krakow and south-eastern city of Tarnow.
He said the investment would be financed from a bank's loan, but added a convertible bonds issue was also possible.
He added said in the future the company also planned to build a supermarket in Nowy Targ and Nowy Sacz, south-eastern Poland.
